CalibrationIniDAO

class CalibrationIniDAO[source]

Bases: DAO[Calibration]

DAO for the single Calibration record in an INI file.

Attributes:
settingsQSettings

INI file opened at PathConfig.calibration_hardware().

Notes

There is only one record, with ID Calibration.ID_VALUE. Each field is stored in the section given by Calibration.get_section_for_property. update, delete and list are not implemented and raise NotImplementedError.

Methods

delete

Not implemented.

insert

Write all fields of the record to the INI file.

list

Not implemented.

select

Read the record from the INI file.

update

Not implemented.
insert(obj)[source]

Write all fields of the record to the INI file.

Parameters:
objCalibration

The record to save.

Returns:
int

Calibration.ID_VALUE on success, or 0 if obj is not valid (nothing is written).

Notes

Existing values are overwritten, so this also works as an update. The file is synced to disk at the end.

select(obj_id)[source]

Read the record from the INI file.

Parameters:
obj_idint

Ignored: there is only one record.

Returns:
Calibration | None

The record read from the file, or None if camera_id is missing or empty.

Raises:
TypeError

If camera_id exists but other fields are missing, since Calibration has no defaults.

ValueError

If an int or float field holds text that cannot be converted.

Notes

Values are converted to int or float according to the Calibration type hints; other fields keep the type returned by QSettings.
